# Flipkart Marketplace Canonical Pack — v10 Production Semantic Quality

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: flipkart.v10.semantic_quality_repair
  status: resolved
  resolution: Corrected templated prose, role misclassifications, and non-specific semantic text using the Flipkart
    Recon Doc.
- issue_id: flipkart.v10.edge_coverage
  status: preserved
  resolution: Preserved v17 deterministic materialized edge coverage.
```

## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

This reusable Flipkart marketplace pack covers Flipkart India order, settlement, commission-fee, cashback, and marketplace reconciliation semantics. Runtime tenant, group, account, and account-binding cards are out of scope and must be supplied by client-runtime packs.

## 2. Validation Contract

Locked full-spectrum validation applies: structural checks, claim consistency, universal semantic profiles, SQL blueprint checks, deterministic edge coverage, and no warnings.

    - many-side duplicate aggregation
    - runtime scope hardcoding

      template: "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cashback_given,\n\

        type: date

      dialect: athena_trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: order_id, item_id
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only

      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_cashback.charged_amount
      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_cashback.is_active

      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_settlement.item_id
      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_settlement.offer_settled_amount
      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_settlement.offer_adjustment_settled_amount

      template: "WITH cashback_agg AS (\n  SELECT order_id, item_id, SUM(charged_amount) AS total_cashback\n  FROM\
        \ zs_observe.flipkart_cashback\n  WHERE is_active = true\n    /* optional_runtime_filter: group_level_id\
        \ = :group_level_id */\n  GROUP BY order_id, item_id\n)\nSELECT cb.order_id, cb.item_id,\n  cb.total_cashback\

        \ 0) AS settlement_offer_amount,\n  cb.total_cashback - COALESCE(s.offer_settled_amount, 0) - COALESCE(s.offer_adjustment_settled_amount,\

    sql_blueprint:
      dialect: athena_trino
      execution_status: template_ready
      grain: settlement_month
      runtime_scope_policy: runtime_filters_from_account_binding_only
      runtime_parameters:
      - name: start_date
        required: false
        type: date
        source: user_input
        description: Optional lower bound for query date.
      - name: end_date
        required: false
        type: date

        required: false
        type: integer

      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_settlement.total_tds_amount
      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_settlement.gst_on_mp_fees
      - column.zs_observe.flipkart_settlement.is_active
      template: "SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', settlement_date) AS settlement_month,\n  SUM(total_tcs_amount) AS total_tcs_amount,\n\
        \  SUM(total_tds_amount) AS total_tds_amount,\n  SUM(gst_on_mp_fees) AS gst_on_mp_fees\nFROM zs_observe.flipkart_settlement\n\
        WHERE is_active = true\n  /* optional_runtime_filter: group_level_id = :group_level_id */\nGROUP BY 1\n\
        ORDER BY 1"

        source: query_pattern

        source: metric
      - name: gst_on_mp_fees
        source: metric
      safety_rules:

      - Do not join on group_level_id across Flipkart tables.

      - stage: base_filter
